task.description: Root-cause diagnosis and scope recommendation for ISS-0531: SPA's tenant-slug-from-realm heuristic strips bpm- unconditionally, breaking the pinned default tenant.

result.note: Root cause: tokenUtils.ts:26-41's resolveTenantSlug/1 does realm.startsWith('bpm-') ? realm.slice(4) : realm unconditionally for every realm; AuthProvider.tsx:93-103 calls tenantsApi.getBySlug with the result, 404s for the default tenant, catch swallows it, tenantDisplayName stays null -> Unknown workspace. Heuristic is NOT globally wrong: frontend-requirements.md:205 documents the real convention realm = 'bpm-' + slug for ordinary tenants (e.g. acme1 <-> bpm-acme1), so stripping is correct in general. It's specifically wrong for the seeded default tenant because lib/letflow/identity/tenant.ex:73,85-86,147-160's validate_default_tenant_pinning/1 enforces (REQ-019-derived changeset invariant) that when slug == 'bpm-default', idp_realm_id MUST equal 'bpm-default' exactly -- slug and realm are pinned identical for this one tenant, breaking the general 'bpm-' + slug pattern by design. Not an R-Co-inherited misconception -- no R-Co doc found stating a convention that would make stripped 'default' correct; the only documented convention (frontend-requirements.md) supports the opposite conclusion. Feasibility of option (b) (mint tenant_id JWT claim): NOT a small config change -- contract-gaps.md:51-70 already documents an existing out-of-band Keycloak mapper drift gap (tracked realm JSON missing a required mapper, added manually via Admin REST API, explicitly flagged unresolved) that a new tenant_id mapper would repeat per-realm, plus likely backend claim-consumption changes -- multi-file, multi-role lift, not frontend-only. Feasibility of option (c) (change seeded tenant's slug): also bigger than it looks -- would require revising tenant.ex's enforced changeset invariant and REQ-019's design doc, exactly the kind of silently-re-decide-a-decision-record CLAUDE.md flags for REVIEWER sign-off, not a quiet seed-data edit. RECOMMENDATION: option (a) -- fix resolveTenantSlug/1 to special-case the default-tenant pinning (e.g. recognize bpm-default as a reserved realm whose slug equals the realm verbatim) rather than blindly stripping. Only option that doesn't touch a settled decision record or require Keycloak provisioning work. Exact implementation shape left to CODE-DESIGNER. Routing: CODE-DESIGNER -> CODE-DESIGN-VALIDATOR -> FRONTEND-DEV (implement in tokenUtils.ts, add/update a unit test covering the bpm-default case) -> normal REVIEWER/TEST gates. No ELIXIR-DEV, no migration, no Keycloak config change needed.
